text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Heads of diplomatic missions in Baghdad congratulate President Saddam Hussein on safety of his son Uday.
- Pan-Arab command of the Arab Baath Socialist Party reviews domestic and political situation in the Arab world.
- Uday receives congratulations from Qatari government.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Oil minister says Iraq discussing ways to supply Turkey with gas.
- Trade ministry takes measures to supply Iraqis with food rations.
- Editorial criticises Turkey over allied force.
- Iraq provides free services to ships calling on its ports on Gulf.
- Supertanker leaves Mina al-Bakr in southern Iraq.
